learner_text: Ǣghwilc hēah ār, hēr on worulde, bið mid frēcnessum ymbseald; efne swā ðā woruldgeðyngða bēoð māran, swā ðā frēcnessa bēoð swīðran. Swā wē magon, be ðǣm, ðā bȳsena oncnāwan and ongietan. Ðæt trēow, ðonne, ðe wiexð on ðǣm wudubearwe, ðæt hit hlīfað ūp ofer eall ðā ōðru trēowu and brǣt hit, ðonne sęmninga storm gestęnt, and se stranga wind, ðonne bið hit swīðlicor gewǣged and geswęnged ðonne se ōðer wudu. Swā bið ēac gelīce be ðǣm hēaclifum and torrum, ðonne hīe hlīfiað feorr ūp ofer ðā ōðre eorðan, hīe ðonne sęmninga feallan onginnað, and full ðearlice hrēosan tō eorðan. Swilce ēac be ðǣm hēagum muntum and dūnum, ðā-ðe hēah standað ofer ealne middangeard, ðā-hwæðre wīte habbað ðæs ealdordōmes, ðæt hīe bēoð geneahhe mid heofonfȳre geðrēade and geðrǣste, and mid līegum geslægene. Swā ðā hēan mihta hēr on worulde hrēosað, and feallað, and tō lore weorðað, and ðisse worulde welan weorðað tō sorge, and ðās eorðlican wundor weorðað tō nāhte.
selection_rationale: Complete first argument: opening thesis about danger with high station; connected tree, cliff and mountain examples; explicit return to human power, wealth and earthly wonders. The following paragraph begins a distinct luxury/death argument and is unassigned.
